r:nephilim.note: Half Human, half Fallen Angel. Not fully flesh, not fully spirit. When their body dies, their soul remains on Earth as an evil spirit (demon).

r:catgirl.note: Created by Human-Animal hybrid program. She was kidnapped as a child and forced into genetic and animal-human hybrid experiments. She was able to escape, only to return home and see her island overrun with monsters and chaos, she tries to find her father, the Shogun, only to see him being fed on. They turn to look at her and she runs toward a door to escape, thats when she lands in DOOR HQ training room.

r:pirate:male.note: Pirated is enchanted by the siren's song

r:shadow entity.note: Evil soul wandering the Earth, no physical body

r:reptilian.note: The Reptilians are from Alpha Draconis in the Draco constellation. They shapeshift to blend in as humans to gain political power and manipulate human society. Sometimes their mimicry slips through and people get glimpses of their reptilian eyes.

r:santa clause.note: Evil Dictator of the North Pole. Terrible work conditions and a surveillance state
